This '''very old Jedi''' was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of [[Shayoto]]. This Jedi lived many centuries, and [[Shayoto's master's master|his master]] lived for hundreds of years as well, having lived through the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]<ref name="darklords3" /> in [[7000 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="darklords3" /> [[5000 BBY/Legends|two thousand years later]].<ref name="NEC" />
